name: entailer-monorepo
description: A logician's-pass linter for software artifacts — evaluate the logical soundness of sentences, prompts, markdown, and repos.

scripts.gen:check: pnpm run gen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/core/src/generated packages/core/schema
